notes: Template structure for a test cycle definition. Each category contains test cases with step-by-step procedures and expected results.

test_cases.title: Fresh install on supported hardware
steps: Ensure the target machine meets minimum hardware requirements
Download the installer from the official distribution channel
Run the installer with default settings
expected_results: Installation proceeds without errors or warnings
Wizard completes and shows success message
Application launches to the main menu within 30 seconds

test_cases.title: Stereo rendering activates on supported display
steps: Launch the application on a zSpace display
Verify that stereoscopic rendering is enabled by default
Observe the 3D depth effect on displayed objects
expected_results: Application launches successfully on zSpace display
Stereo rendering is active (left/right eye images differ)
Objects appear with correct depth separation

test_cases.title: Stylus primary button interaction
steps: Point the zSpace stylus at an interactive object
expected_results: Object highlights or shows hover feedback
Object is selected or activated as expected
